title: Ultrametric organization of energy landscapes on random Erdős--Rényi graphs: topological origin of barrier hierarchy
summary: In the present work, we investigate the hypothesis of the ultrametric organization of abstract energy landscapes defined on random Erdős--Rényi graphs. Within the proposed model, each vertex of the graph is assigned a random free energy uniformly distributed on a given interval, and the kinetics of the system is described by a Markov process with a Kramers transition rate matrix. Based on the spectral decomposition of this matrix, a kinetic metric between basins of attraction is constructed.
